migrations.notes: Entity-data lane E3 (2026-09-17): the closed `Scope` enum gains `write_entities`, the scope gating the entities-family mutations (`/client/entities:create`, `/client/entities/{id}:patch|:apply|:promote|:demote`). `Scope::operator_default()` includes it, so operator sessions minted by the runtime carry it automatically; a client that enumerates scopes must accept the new literal. Reads (`GET /client/schema`, `POST /client/entities:query`, `GET /client/entities/{agent_id}/{entity_id}`) stay under `read_inventory`. Everything else in this version is additive: the `schema` + `entities` families and their DTOs (ClientSchema, ClientAspect*, ClientEntity*), the `data.entity_changed` event projection (leaves entity_id / path / op / kind), and the WebSocket subprotocol literal `advance.client.2026-09-17`.
